The 60 wt% sample has the most uniform surface structure. Figure 17. The GDC is a very thin layer (on the order of tens of micrometers). (Top row) air entrapment is the major defect which significantly worsened upon dilution. The sample with 60 wt% solids demonstrated the worst surface roughness due to air entrapment.
